name: EPIC 220486035
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.3 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,210 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.03 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,873 K at its surface.
